OMIM_API_KEY.purpose: Look up Mendelian disease–gene relationships and clinical variant records for interpretation.
OMIM_API_KEY.without: OMIM tools return no data without it. Free for academic use.

DISGENET_API_KEY.purpose: Pull curated gene–disease association scores and supporting evidence.
DISGENET_API_KEY.without: Limited public data works without it; the key unlocks full access.

PHARMVAR_API_KEY.purpose: Resolve pharmacogene star-allele definitions (e.g. CYP2D6, CYP2C19).
PHARMVAR_API_KEY.without: PharmVar tools are blocked without it.

ONCOKB_API_TOKEN.purpose: Annotate cancer variants with oncogenicity and matched therapy implications.
ONCOKB_API_TOKEN.without: Runs in demo mode (BRAF, TP53, ROS1 only) without a token.

CLUE_API_KEY.purpose: Query Connectivity Map drug–gene perturbation signatures for repurposing.
CLUE_API_KEY.without: CLUE tools are blocked without it. The key is free.

MCULE_API_KEY.purpose: Check purchasability and pricing of chemical compounds.
MCULE_API_KEY.without: Compound search works without it; the key unlocks ordering and availability.

BRENDA_EMAIL.purpose: BRENDA account email — retrieves enzyme kinetics, substrates, and parameters.
BRENDA_EMAIL.without: BRENDA tools are blocked without an account (paired with the password).

BRENDA_PASSWORD.purpose: BRENDA account password — authenticates the enzyme-data SOAP API.
BRENDA_PASSWORD.without: Required together with the BRENDA email.

ESM_API_KEY.purpose: Run EvolutionaryScale ESM protein language models (embeddings, structure prediction).
ESM_API_KEY.without: ESM Forge tools are blocked without it.

BIOGRID_ACCESS_KEY.purpose: Retrieve protein–protein and genetic interaction networks.
BIOGRID_ACCESS_KEY.without: BioGRID tools are blocked without it. The key is free.

ADDGENE_API_KEY.purpose: Look up plasmids and deposited constructs from the Addgene repository.
ADDGENE_API_KEY.without: Addgene tools are blocked without it.

HF_TOKEN.purpose: Download Hugging Face models and datasets used by structure/sequence tools.
HF_TOKEN.without: Public models work without it; needed for gated or private repos.

NCBI_API_KEY.purpose: Search PubMed and fetch citation metrics (iCite) and PubTator annotations.
NCBI_API_KEY.without: Works at 3 requests/sec without it; the key raises the limit to 10/sec.

SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY.purpose: Search papers and traverse citation graphs via Semantic Scholar.
SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY.without: Works at ~1 request/sec without it; the key raises rate limits.

USPTO_API_KEY.purpose: Search US patents and patent-application full text.
USPTO_API_KEY.without: USPTO patent tools are blocked without it.

FDA_API_KEY.purpose: Query FDA drug labels, adverse-event reports (FAERS), and recalls.
FDA_API_KEY.without: Works at 240 requests/min without it; the key raises it to 120,000/day.

FDC_API_KEY.purpose: Look up food and nutrient composition from USDA FoodData Central.
FDC_API_KEY.without: Falls back to a shared, rate-limited DEMO_KEY without it.

OPENAI_API_KEY.purpose: Generate text embeddings for the semantic tool finder.
OPENAI_API_KEY.without: The tool finder falls back to local embeddings without it.

AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY.purpose: Use Azure-hosted OpenAI models for embeddings (enterprise alternative to OpenAI).
AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY.without: Optional alternative to OpenAI — leave blank if you don't use Azure.

NVIDIA_API_KEY.purpose: Call NVIDIA NIM model endpoints (hosted inference for bio/chem models).
NVIDIA_API_KEY.without: NIM tools are blocked without it.

BOLTZ_MCP_SERVER_HOST.purpose: URL of a self-hosted Boltz structure-prediction MCP server.
BOLTZ_MCP_SERVER_HOST.without: Leave blank unless you run your own Boltz server.

ESM_MCP_SERVER_HOST.purpose: URL of a self-hosted ESM MCP server.
ESM_MCP_SERVER_HOST.without: Leave blank unless you run your own ESM server.

EXPERT_FEEDBACK_MCP_SERVER_URL.purpose: URL of a self-hosted expert-feedback MCP service.
EXPERT_FEEDBACK_MCP_SERVER_URL.without: Leave blank unless you run this service.

TXAGENT_MCP_SERVER_HOST.purpose: URL of a self-hosted TxAgent MCP server.
TXAGENT_MCP_SERVER_HOST.without: Leave blank unless you run your own TxAgent.

USPTO_MCP_SERVER_HOST.purpose: URL of a self-hosted USPTO MCP server.
USPTO_MCP_SERVER_HOST.without: Leave blank unless you run your own USPTO server.
